definitions.ask: Should the monitor skill tell an agent to record its prerequisite on its own bead before it polls another bead?
definitions.why: The root gap was a missing edge; a relaunched phase then waits natively on the bead.

choices.label: Agents add the dep edge first, so bead views and any relaunch see the prerequisite
Only the monitor label names the blocker; the bead graph stays as authored
